flags.evidence: Selected checkpoint 113f01a M015 inviscid metadata says converged after 20000 steps at 1.6908 residual orders, but last400 Cd spans −1.270249..1.306778 and Cl −1.039743..1.379698; report.tex:223 acknowledges the near-zero-drag expectation. M200 laminar metadata says converged at step625 with 3.00036 orders, but final50 Cd changes −1.225659→−1.020064 (16.8% of initial magnitude), demonstrating the supplied force stability criterion is not met. Both selected force CSVs and metadata match checkpoint 113f01a. No synthetic data or strict inner failure counts inferred.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
